rules.label: Tumblr Premium promo in the right rail

meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Tumblr logged-out dashboard: sign-up bar, Premium ad, media and avatars, tags, counts
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA) on the tumblr.com front page; selectors were run on the saved live DOM. Blog pages on name.tumblr.com use per-blog themes and were not checked, so these rules target the dashboard-style front page and may match nothing there. Classes are hashed (for example article.FtjPK), so rules use the article element, data-testid and aria-label values; the aria-label ones are English-only.

- **Sign-up bar**: the bottom bar is the one div whose grandchild holds the Sign up and Log in buttons (1 on mobile and desktop, LIVE). The header Log in button is outside it.
- **Ads**: a[data-testid=house-right-rail-ad], the Tumblr Premium promo in the right rail, 1 on desktop, 0 on mobile (LIVE). A bait div[data-testid=adBlockTest] exists and is deliberately left alone, since hiding an ad-block test element can trigger anti-ad-block notices.
- **Post media** (Show/Blur/Hide): article figures that are not avatars, 9 on mobile and 32 on desktop (LIVE).
- **Avatars** (Show/Blur/Hide): article figure[aria-label=Avatar] (LIVE).
- **Post footers**: footer[aria-label=Post footer], 6 on mobile and 20 on desktop; the counts live inside it (LIVE).
- **Post tags**: the div holding the tag-link anchors, 3 on mobile and 11 on desktop (LIVE).
- **Trending Blogs**: the module around ul[aria-label=Trending Blogs], 1 on desktop; the mobile layout has no such column (LIVE).

Not verified: logged-in dashboard, sponsored posts (none appeared logged out), blog theme pages, the Explore page, other languages. Fixtures real.html and desktop-real.html are structure captures with text removed.
